period_note: CONSOLIDATED (Group) basis, matching this bank's main Q4/annual series (see sources.json reporting_basis). Source: Southeast Bank's own BSEC-mandated 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and by the Board' disclosure table, embedded in its annual report (a corporate-governance disclosure most banks answer with a checkbox, but which Southeast Bank answers with an actual Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 balance-sheet-and-income-statement table for that report's own year, plus a comparative column for the prior year). Balance-sheet line items are the 1 January to 30 September 2019 period-end snapshot (basis reported). Income-statement line items and EPS are CUMULATIVE FROM 1 JANUARY 2019 ("1 January to 30 September 2019" exactly as the table's own column header states), not discrete-quarter figures -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix, basis reported, same convention as CITYBANK. Balance-sheet identity (Total assets = Total liabilities + Total equity) holds to within a consistent ~BDT 8-11m gap (~0.002-0.004% of total assets), most plausibly a small Non-controlling-interest balance not broken out as its own row in this vintage of the table -- see the 2021-2025 vintage, which adds an explicit NCI row and closes this same gap almost exactly. Cumulative net profit after tax increases monotonically Q1->Q2->Q3 within 2019 (validated; no violation). FY2019 itself has no independent cross-check: the FY2020 report's own copy of this table exists but its data rows failed to extract entirely (see the 2020 file's note), so no later report reproduces FY2019's figures within this table. This report's own 2018-comparative column does independently corroborate 2018's data (matches the FY2018 report's own contemporaneous table exactly, aside from the already-documented EPS restatement -- see the 2018 file's note), which is cross-validation of 2018, not of 2019.
